scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev:wait -w apps/desktop"
scripts.dev:web-only: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
